title: Speed up slowest CLI test binaries; record measured before/after
summary: Retry of job 20261025-202447-xgk9 (the user's request is to try again), keeping the accepted approach from the earlier retry: no nextest, cut real time in the slowest athena-cli test binaries, plus the secrets.rs scan memo and shorter run_check poll schedule, each with a behavior-preserving test. Goal: full `cargo test --locked` under 7 minutes; audience is the user reading docs/decisions.md and later job times.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check suite time under 7 minutes and failing tests still fail, not just that edits exist.
cargo test and clippy criteria; each production change has a test.
Decision numbers are measured or labeled brain-measured.
Find the cause of time per binary rather than skipping tests.
Behavior criteria runnable by the verifier with cargo commands.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The prior accepted reading (memo, poll schedule, test-binary speedups, nextest rejected) stands and the earlier attempt's changes are gone, so this starts from base.
Compile 67 s vs run 673 s and nextest 584 s are the brain's measurements and are recorded as such; per-binary before/after times must be measured in the job.
athena.toml, ci.yml and tool pins stay unchanged because nextest and sccache are not adopted.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/decisions.md has a new decision with per-binary before and after times (lifecycle, job_plan, drain, retry, steward), measured the same way in the job and labeled measured, with the cause found for each and the total suite time.

The decision records compile 67 s vs run 673 s (brain-measured, 4 cores), lists cargo-nextest 0.9.148 (584 s vs 673 s, about 13%) as rejected, and lists sccache (D79) and a shared target dir as considered; no unmeasured number is claimed.
No test is deleted, ignored, filtered or has assertions weakened; the test count is not lower than before. athena.toml, ci.yml and tool pins are unchanged. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Production changes are limited to the secret-scan memo in crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs and the shorter poll schedule in crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs; each leaves behavior unchanged and has a test (memo equals uncached scanning; poll schedule still detects completion, failure and timeout).
Run `cargo test --locked`: it passes with every test running, total run time is under 7 minutes on the job's machine, and a failing test still fails the run.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Adopting sccache or changing CI workflow
Deleting, ignoring or weakening any test
departures: Higher cost and time than reference: the full suite (~7+ minutes) must be run several times to measure per-binary before/after, and the earlier attempt was rejected.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time: it shortens the test suite that every job's checks and retries repeat, and a previous attempt was rejected.
